reason: Both correctly diagnose normal refrigerant, thermostat and defrost-expansion noises, recommend no part and no engineer, and neither asks the sensible level/clearance questions. Conversation 2 edges ahead because it explicitly states no part is needed and gives the correct escalation boundary ('squealing, grinding or loud rattling'), matching the ground truth's warranty trigger, whereas Conversation 1 ties any concern solely to a loss of cooling, which is slightly overbroad since an abnormal mechanical noise would warrant a Bosch call even with cooling intact. Conversation 1's fuller explanation of the defrost cycle is a genuine strength, but not enough to outweigh the better-calibrated boundary in Conversation 2.
